title: Kanne Kalaimaane
desc: Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, his grandmother does not want his wife to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.

title: Kalavani
desc: Arivazhagan, a mischievous young man, falls in love with Maheshwari, who belongs to the rival village. He abducts her and marries her after she confesses her feelings for him.

title: Saindhav
desc: A man with a traumatic past is compelled to encounter a crime boss so that he can rescue his daughter from a health problem.

title: Saakini Daakini
desc: Two police trainees set out on a dangerous mission in order to investigate the kidnapping of a girl from a nightclub when they fail to get the police's help.

title: Pisasu
desc: Upon witnessing the death of a young girl in an accident, Siddharth, a violinist, begins to feel a supernatural presence in his house. The mystery begins to unfold when he meets the girl's father.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

title: Sundeep Kishans Michael
desc: Michael, a gangster mentored by a Mumbai-based crime boss, aspires for greater things in life. However, an assassination mission and unexpected love complicate his goals.

title: Naan Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kaali
desc: Bharath, a surgeon working in the US, embarks on a mission to India, to find his biological parents and reconcile with them.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Prince
desc: A teacher becomes smitten with his British colleague. However, their relationship is soon tested by unforeseen challenges.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Bhai
desc: A ruthless crime lord's plan to eliminate a police officer backfires when the henchman assigned to kill him discovers the target is his long-lost brother.

title: Thuparivaalan
desc: An experienced detective investigates the death of a child's pet dog and inadvertently unravels a sinister web of unsolved murders.

title: Kalki
desc: A diligent cop, Kalki, takes on the case of Sekhar's murder in Kollapuram, a village ruled by his powerful brother, Narsappa.
